description: This source file defines data structures and functions related to displaying and resolving tool-related information, such as summaries of tools and configuration parsing for a tool display registry. It includes a struct for summarizing tool information and an enum managing configurations loaded from JSON, with methods to resolve tool display details based on input arguments.

classes.name: ToolDisplaySummary
classes.description: A struct representing a summarized view of a tool, including name, emoji, title, label, verb, and detail, with computed properties for display lines.

classes.name: ToolDisplayRegistry
classes.description: An enum responsible for loading, providing default configurations, and resolving tool display summaries based on tool names and arguments.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Resolves and returns a ToolDisplaySummary for a given tool name and arguments.

methods.name: loadConfig
methods.description: Loads configuration data from a JSON resource or returns a default configuration if loading fails.

methods.name: defaultConfig
methods.description: Returns a default ToolDisplayConfig object embedded in the code.

methods.name: titleFromName
methods.description: Generates a user-friendly title from a tool name string.

methods.name: normalizeVerb
methods.description: Normalizes a verb string, replacing underscores with spaces.

methods.name: readDetail
methods.description: Constructs a detailed string for read actions, including offset and limit if available.

methods.name: pathDetail
methods.description: Extracts path detail string from arguments.

methods.name: firstValue
methods.description: Retrieves the first non-empty value from arguments based on a list of keys.

methods.name: renderValue
methods.description: Renders a value as a string suitable for display.

methods.name: valueForKeyPath
methods.description: Accesses nested values in arguments using dot-separated key paths.

methods.name: shortenHomeInString
methods.description: Replaces the home directory path with ~ in a string.
